title: The Depot dashboard now supports five more languages
summary: Use the Depot dashboard in Brazilian Portuguese, French, Japanese, Korean, or Simplified Chinese. Follow your browser's language or choose your own from the sidebar.
body_markdown:
The Depot dashboard is now available in Brazilian Portuguese, French, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese, alongside English. Thanks to our partnership with[General Translation](https://generaltranslation.com/) , we localized the dashboard in under three weeks, from initial implementation to public launch.


You can review builds, check GitHub Actions runs, and manage organization settings with navigation, labels, and controls in your preferred language. Localization is available to everyone using the dashboard.


## Choose your language


Depot uses your browser's language preferences to choose a supported language automatically. If none of your preferred languages are supported, the dashboard uses English.


To choose a different language:


1. Open the[Depot dashboard](https://depot.dev/orgs) .
2. Click your organization name at the top of the sidebar, or the Depot icon if the sidebar is collapsed.
3. Open **Language** and select the language you want to use.


Depot remembers your choice in that browser and uses it instead of your browser's language preference. Each teammate can choose their own language. If you use another browser or device, you can make a separate selection there.


## A translated dashboard


Translations cover the interface across projects and builds, Depot CI workflows, GitHub Actions, test results, cache, registry, billing, and settings. GitHub Actions analytics charts also use your selected language for date labels.


Open the[dashboard](https://depot.dev/orgs) to try it. If you spot a translation that could be clearer,[let us know](https://depot.dev/help) .
